legal.privacy:
This policy explains how Shalom Studio handles your information when you use this website or order from us.

What we collect: the details you choose to send us, such as your name, phone number, delivery address and the photos you want printed. You send these to us yourself through WhatsApp, Instagram or Google Drive. This website does not collect them for us, and it has no accounts or payment forms.

How we use it: only to prepare, print, deliver and support your order and to answer your questions. We do not sell your details or photos, and we do not use your photos for advertising or display them without your permission.

How long we keep it: we keep your photos and order details only as long as needed to complete your order and handle any problems with it. You can ask us to delete your photos at any time.

Third-party services: this site links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Drive and Google Maps and loads fonts from Google Fonts. Those services have their own privacy policies. If website analytics is switched on by the owner, it records visits in aggregate and is skipped when your browser sends Do Not Track.

Your choices: contact us on the WhatsApp number or Instagram shown on this site to see, correct or delete your information. We may update this policy from time to time, and the latest version is always on this page.
legal.terms:
By placing an order with Shalom Studio you agree to these terms.

Orders and prices: prices are shown in Indian rupees (₹) and may change. An order is confirmed only when we reply to you on WhatsApp with the final price, delivery charge and expected date.

Your photos: you confirm that you own the photos you send, or have permission to print them. We cannot print material that is unlawful, hateful or infringes someone else's rights, and we may decline such orders.

Custom products: because each item is made specially for you, we cannot accept returns or give refunds for change of mind. If your item arrives damaged or printed differently from the design you approved, contact us within 3 days of delivery with photos and we will reprint or refund it.

Colours and quality: printed colours can look slightly different from your screen. We will tell you if a photo is too small or blurry to print well, but the final choice to go ahead is yours.

Delivery: delivery times are estimates and can be affected by couriers, weather and festivals. We are not responsible for delays outside our control.

Liability: our responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. These terms are governed by the laws of India.
